# ==========================================================================
# STAT ALLOCATION - automatic allocation stays OFF (statsAddAuto 0) until you
# switch it on yourself: spent stat points cannot be taken back.
#
# Rules of this build: STR stays at 16 (never add), AGI and LUK are never raised;
# priority INT 60-65, then DEX 25-30, remaining affordable points to VIT.
#
# Checked 2026-11-06 with tools\stat_plan.py against the real character data
# (Base Lv 15: STR 16 AGI 1 VIT 1 INT 10 DEX 15 LUK 1, 20 unspent points):
#   - the server's cost of the next point matches 2 + (stat - 1) // 10 for all six stats
#   - spent 85 + unspent 20 = 105 = the standard budget for Lv 15 (difference 0)
#   - budget at Base Lv 50 = 420 points, 335 of them still to spend
#
# Chosen plan (ending A, picked 2026-11-06), in this order:
#   INT 10 -> 60   245 points, reached at Base Lv 43
#   DEX 15 -> 25    34 points, Lv 46
#   INT 60 -> 65    39 points, Lv 49
#   DEX 25 -> 29    16 points, Lv 50   (DEX 30 needs 4 more points than Lv 50 gives)
#   Result at Lv 50: STR 16  AGI 1  VIT 1  INT 65  DEX 29  LUK 1, 1 point unspent.
# Not chosen: ending B (stop at INT 60 / DEX 25, then VIT 22): "60 int, 25 dex, 22 vit".
# statsAddAuto_dontUseBonus 1 makes the targets count BASE stats only (equipment and
# buffs, e.g. the +1 INT now, would otherwise count towards the target).
# To switch on: set statsAddAuto 1 (or type `conf statsAddAuto 1` in the OpenKore window);
# the 20 points that are unspent now would go into INT first.
# ==========================================================================
statsAddAuto 0
statsAddAuto_dontUseBonus 1
statsAddAuto_list 60 int, 25 dex, 65 int, 29 dex
